design: At L5H5 capture actual post-RMS/RoPE q,k,q2,k2 and mixed values via squared_attention entry. Reconstruct signed A=(QK/128)*(Q2K2/128), causal mask, H=A V. Matched receiver/donor: routing=dA Vr;value=Ar dV;interaction=dA dV. Audit sum=Hd-Hr. Intervene each, routing+value, sum and full native head difference at query/source/both; reciprocal task,nuisance,identity across all H777lexicalcohorts.
limitations: Receiver-centered algebra, not unique causal attribution; downstream nonlinear effects not additive. Routing is signed, not probabilities. Value includes layer-local and layer0bus mixture; no claim of purely lexical content or compact routing yet. Require equal sequence length and aligned selected source position.
